title: I can't find a way to connect another device to xDrip+
symptom: The user connected xDrip+ on their Android phone with Miao Miao, but cannot find a way to allow multiple family members to monitor the data, as claimed on the Miao Miao website.
fix: The thread suggests several methods for sharing data, including setting up a Nightscout site, setting up a sync group, using Dexcom Share partners, or setting up a Tidepool account. The user successfully set up a sync group.
evidence_quote: set up a sync group and members of your group can install xDrip+ on their Android and see the exact same thing you see on your copy of xDrip+
